potentialProductDefects.case: Read-only E11 fiscal probe intermittently returns HTTP 409 instead of a stable invoice response or profile-denial response immediately after native login, observed with both F and A actors on distinct scoped-clock attempts.
potentialProductDefects.diagnosis: The auth middleware updates sesiones.expira_at on every authenticated request, including GET /api/auth/me and fiscal GETs. E11 reads run serializable transactions; a concurrent update of the same session row may produce a PostgreSQL conflict translated to REVISION_OBSOLETA (HTTP 409). F's fourth-attempt body confirms REVISION_OBSOLETA; A's earlier 409 body was not captured. The exact concurrent transaction was not proven, and neither 409 demonstrates an A data leak.
